Topics · Is there a God?

Is human dignity real, or just an agreement?

If a stranger's worth survives a vote, the world holds more than atoms and agreements. What could it rest on?

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And We have certainly honored the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.

Quran · Al-Isra 17:70

Translation

what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him? For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor. You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

Original · Hebrew

מָֽה־אֱנ֥וֹשׁ כִּֽי־תִזְכְּרֶ֑נּוּ וּבֶן־אָ֝דָ֗ם כִּ֣י תִפְקְדֶֽנּוּ׃ וַתְּחַסְּרֵ֣הוּ מְּ֭עַט מֵאֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכָב֖וֹד וְהָדָ֣ר תְּעַטְּרֵֽהוּ׃ תַּ֭מְשִׁילֵהוּ בְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣י יָדֶ֑יךָ כֹּ֝ל שַׁ֣תָּה תַֽחַת־רַגְלָֽיו׃

the Psalms · 8:4-6

World English Bible

Picture a person no one would miss: poor, old, forgotten, of no use to anyone. Suppose every government on earth decided this person had no worth. Would they be right or wrong? If you say wrong, you have said that dignity is not an agreement. It is something an agreement can fail to honour. That is the fact this argument starts from. This verse states it without conditions: the children of Adam have been honoured. It names no race, no faith, no merit. It says all of them.

A question for you

Could everyone be wrong about a person's worth?

If you sayYes. Worth does not depend on opinion.
ThenThen you hold that at least one moral fact stands, whoever denies it. The next part asks what could make it so.
If you sayNo. Worth is whatever societies give it.
ThenThen a society that denies it is not mistaken, only different. Many thoughtful people hold this. It is worth asking whether you can say so of the worst cases.
If you sayI feel yes, but I cannot defend it.
ThenThat is where most honest people stand. The feeling does not prove it. The next part asks what would.

Part 2 of 3

﴿مِنْ أَجْلِ ذَٰلِكَ كَتَبْنَا عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنَّهُۥ مَن قَتَلَ نَفْسًۢا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ أَوْ فَسَادٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا وَمَنْ أَحْيَاهَا فَكَأَنَّمَآ أَحْيَا ٱلنَّاسَ جَمِيعًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ إِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنْهُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لَمُسْرِفُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Because of that, We decreed upon the Children of Israel that whoever kills a soul unless for a soul[258] or for corruption [done] in the land[259] - it is as if he had slain mankind entirely. And whoever saves one[260] - it is as if he had saved mankind entirely. And Our messengers had certainly come to them with clear proofs. Then indeed many of them, [even] after that, throughout the land, were transgressors.[261]

Translator's notes

[258] i.e., in legal retribution for murder. [259] i.e., that requiring the death penalty. [260] Or refrains from killing. [261] Heedless of Allāh's limits, negligent of their responsibilities.

Quran · Al-Ma'idah 5:32

Translation

Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!

Original · Hebrew

הַ֭צֵּל לְקֻחִ֣ים לַמָּ֑וֶת וּמָטִ֥ים לַ֝הֶ֗רֶג אִם־תַּחְשֽׂוֹךְ׃

Proverbs · 24:11

World English Bible

If dignity is real, what kind of thing is it? It weighs nothing. No microscope finds it. A process that selects only for survival would give us feelings that help us survive, and it has no reason to give us true ones. So two main accounts compete. Either worth is a bare fact in a universe that does not care, or persons matter because the Source of everything is good and made them to matter. This verse sets one life against all people.

A question for you

Which account of human worth costs you the least?

If you sayA basic truth that needs no explanation.
ThenA strong view, held by serious philosophers without belief in God. Its cost is that the deepest moral fact sits unexplained in a world indifferent to it.
If you sayA useful human invention.
ThenThen it is real the way money is real. The cost shows in the worst case: an invention can be repealed.
If you sayIt comes from a Source that is good.
ThenThat explains why worth is real and why you can know it. Its cost is the question of what makes that Source good.

Translation of the meaning

Quran · Ash-Shams 91:9

Translation

He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

Original · Hebrew

נְקִ֥י כַפַּ֗יִם וּֽבַר־לֵ֫בָ֥ב אֲשֶׁ֤ר ׀ לֹא־נָשָׂ֣א לַשָּׁ֣וְא נַפְשִׁ֑י וְלֹ֖א נִשְׁבַּ֣ע לְמִרְמָֽה׃

the Psalms · 24:4

World English Bible

To be clear: no one needs belief in God to be good, and many without it are deeply good. The argument concerns what goodness is, not who has it. One more fact needs explaining: you can tell. A child knows unfairness without philosophy. If this were only a useful habit, you might expect seeing through it to weaken it, yet few who try stop finding cruelty wrong. One line here says a person was shown two roads. The other says the one who helps the soul grow has succeeded.

A question for you

What does your sense of right and wrong seem like to you?

If you sayA tool that evolved.
ThenIt may well have a history. How a sense reached us does not settle whether it tracks something real, as with the eye.
If you saySomething that shows me what is really there.
ThenThen you trust it as you trust sight. What it is showing you is the question to carry.
If you sayA voice I wish I could quiet.
ThenIf it is heavy, nothing here will add to it. There is a way of meeting it without fear.
